reviews.title: Agujero para la cabeza no ajustable
reviews.body: El arnés está muy bien y es de calidad, además es bonito.  Para mí shihtzu no es el más recomendable porque tiene mucho pelo y como el agujero para la cabeza no es ajustable es complicado ponérselo y quitárselo, de ahí que no le ponga 5 estrellas. Para perros con cabeza más pequeña y pelo corto es ideal.

reviews.title: Se ajusta bien y tiran menos

reviews.title: Great Fit, Secure, and Peace of Mind on Walks
reviews.body:
This harness has been a great fit for my 10 lb Maltese. It sits comfortably on him (at least he sure seems happy wearing it), and the sizing is spot-on without being too tight or awkward.
What I really like is how secure it feels. The design gives me solid control, and I can quickly pick him up if needed—huge bonus when a larger dog comes running over. That added peace of mind makes walks a lot more enjoyable.
It’s well-made, easy to put on, and looks sharp in black too. Overall, a dependable harness that balances comfort, safety, and style. Highly recommend for small dogs!
reviews.date: Reseñado en Canadá el 26 de mayo de 2026
